meta.name: Score and route Facebook Marketplace leads with OpenAI, Supabase, and Slack

parameters.text:
=Analyze this Facebook Marketplace inquiry and extract the following fields:

- intent (choose one: price_inquiry, availability_inquiry, product_question, general_message)
- product_mentioned
- product_id (if unknown, return "unknown")
- summary

Return ONLY valid JSON in this exact format:

{
  "intent": "price_inquiry",
  "product_mentioned": "blue couch",
  "product_id": "unknown",
  "summary": "Customer asking about price of blue couch"
}

Do not include markdown, bullet points, or explanations.

Message: {{ $json.messaging[0].message.text }}

parameters.content:
## Inquiry Capture Layer
Captures incoming messages from Facebook Marketplace in real time using a webhook trigger. This is the entry point of the workflow where raw customer inquiries are received and passed forward for processing and analysis.

## AI Processing & Structuring
Uses an AI model to analyze the inquiry, extract key fields like intent and product details, and safely parse the response into structured JSON format for reliable downstream processing.

## Data Storage & Lead Scoring
Stores the structured inquiry data in Supabase for persistence and tracking, then calculates a lead score based on intent to determine the potential value and urgency of the customer inquiry.

## Hot Lead Identification
Evaluates whether the inquiry qualifies as a high-priority lead based on lead score criteria (≥ 5). This step ensures that high-intent prospects are immediately identified for rapid action.

## Warm & Cold Lead Routing
Further segments non-hot leads into warm and cold categories based on lead score, then routes them to appropriate Slack channels with tailored messaging for prioritization and follow-up strategy.

## Hot Lead Alerting
Sends real-time notifications for qualified hot leads to a Slack channel, ensuring the sales team is instantly informed and can respond quickly to high-intent customer inquiries.

This workflow captures Facebook Marketplace inquiries, uses OpenAI to extract structured data, stores it in Supabase, calculates a lead score, and sends alerts to different Slack channels based on lead priority (hot, warm, cold).

## How It Works
- The workflow starts when a new inquiry is received from Facebook Marketplace via the trigger node.
- The message is sent to an AI model to extract structured details like intent, product mentioned, and summary.
- The AI response is parsed into clean JSON format to ensure consistency and avoid errors.
- The structured data is stored in Supabase for tracking and future analysis.
- A lead score is calculated based on the customer’s intent to determine priority.
- The workflow evaluates the score to classify the lead as hot, warm, or cold.
- Based on classification, the system routes the inquiry to the appropriate Slack channel.
- Sales teams receive real-time notifications, enabling faster and more effective responses.


## Setup Steps

- Create a Facebook App and configure webhook permissions for page messages.
- Set up the Facebook Trigger node in n8n with your App ID and required fields.
- Connect an OpenAI account and configure the AI node with the prompt for data extraction.
- Add a Code node to safely parse the AI response into JSON format.
- Configure Supabase credentials and create a table to store inquiry data.
- Add a Code node to implement lead scoring logic based on intent.
- Use IF nodes to segment leads into hot, warm, and cold categories.
- Connect Slack nodes and configure channels for each lead type.
- Test the workflow using sample messages and verify data flow and notifications.
- Activate the workflow to start processing real-time inquiries automatically.
